creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From the owner's note (2026-11-13), read back to him and confirmed: when a group, or a maker with helpers, starts work, an agent tells Muster the work is in progress and later that it is done. If Muster sees no activity for a while before "done", it pings: first the coordinator, then the helpers one by one if nobody answers, asking whether the work is still going or finished, and to say so if finished. A ping nobody answers is a warning that something is stuck. Some action should then unstick the group, such as nudging the coordinator.

Muster already sends a stall notice once a group is held up on a member; this extends that with declared work, a done verb and escalating pings. Raised as "I wonder if", so an idea until the owner commits to it.
title: Muster pings a group that has gone quiet on declared work, escalating from its coordinator to its helpers
